#025 · Mouse Pokémon

Pikachu

Electric

Kanto · Generation 1

Pikachu is an Electric-type Mouse Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 6 kg. It evolves from Pichu and into Raichu. Its highest base stat is Speed (90), with a base stat total of 320.
